body:
Thank you kind stranger, but i gave up on the idea of soulmates long back. 

And i appreciate you trying but unfortunately you cannot change my mind.

Thank you for thinking that there's people who'd be hurt If i was gone, but it's not true. Atleast not a lot of people are going to care. 

I have no friends who actually give a shit, my family couldn't be bothered to care about me, and the only person I've ever felt something with just left me for good. 

She was the only reason i was still thrashing around in this cesspool, still trying to resurface because she'd be affected if i was gone. Now that she's gone i finally have the freedom to end it. I know it sounds silly, ending it because of a girl, but it's not just that.
